info.name: Automation Anywhere API Task Execution AccessDetails AttributeValues API

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: credentialAttributeId
params.description: Filter attribute values by this credential attribute ID

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter attribute values scoped to this user ID

params.name: encryptionKey
params.description: Encryption key identifier for decrypting attribute values

items.docs: Retrieves all attribute values for a specific credential. Returns the current values of each attribute defined on the credential. The credentialAttributeId, userId, and encryptionKey query parameters can be used to filter the returned attribute values.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

items.docs: Sets or creates new attribute values for a specific credential. Attribute values are the actual secret data (e.g., passwords) stored against credential attribute definitions. Values are encrypted at rest using the Credential Vault key pair.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: attributeValueId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential attribute value

items.docs: Updates the value of a specific attribute on a credential. Used to rotate passwords, API keys, or other secrets without changing the credential's structure. The new value is encrypted and stored securely.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: attributeValueId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential attribute value

items.docs: Removes a specific attribute value from a credential. After deletion, the attribute definition remains but the stored value is permanently removed from the Credential Vault.
